title: Brand and Brand builder show a translated sentence for every failure — never 'HTTP 403', the engine's raw error text, or a job named '?'
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap packages/design/tracy-brand-engine/test/client-failure.test.mjs
S2: Record the exit code, the '# fail' line and the result of each test named in run.tests.
expect: refusalCode maps 401/403 to NOT_ALLOWED and a code-less refusal to UNAVAILABLE; failureText gives a sentence for every known code and job.failed.other for an unknown one; hostOfInput files an own-site refusal under the site's host, never '?'.
evidence: #811 F-S5-008: tabs.tsx built the failed job as { host: url ?? '?', error: { code: 'HTTP 403' } } and JobProgress printed job.error.error for any untranslated code.
fence: The client's failure mapping (pure functions); no browser.

tests: a refusal with no code of its own is named by its kind, never as "HTTP <status>"
every failure reads as a translated sentence; an unknown code gets the general one
the job a refusal leaves behind is named by the site it was for, never "?"
